rv.q: It’s a thoroughly entertaining, at times mind-warping exploration of how magical we still find the idea of being able to predict the future, five centuries after Nostradamus.

Derren Brown has been providing water-cooler moments such as playing Russian Roulette live on television for 26 years. But it is his live shows that are the most impressive, where audiences continue to be baffled and entertained in equal measure. Only Human is Brown’s first live show in over three years, and boy it’s a good one.
For that alone, he deserves our respect and applause.
In this brand-new production, Derren Brown combines mind-reading, psychological illusion, and breathtaking storytelling in a way that is both deeply personal and utterly electrifying.

cn.t: Brown's latest mentalism showcase earns strong reviews for its slick theatricality and his masterful ability to mesmerize audiences, blending observational skills with engaging stagecraft that leaves viewers questioning reality.
